Per `vision.prediction_philosophy`, act on `convergence_summary.look_now`: forward-watch `ai_judgment_exclusion_u4` vs live primary, block auto knob priors while calibration conflicts persist, treat `min_conviction` as churn guard, and count shadow-differentiation weeks toward `filtered_cohort_track`. Top `trajectory_evidence.model_focus_candidates` (`hold->buy`, `buy->strong_buy` at 1w positive_rate 0.25; `realization_lag` / 1w vs 4w) imply an assessment-model timing/conviction delay gap, not a raw screen miss. `hypothesis_integrity.tracks.ai_judgment` is within tolerance with empty `selection_feedback_flags` (prefer thesis review over crude stops); `momentum_grace` is out of tolerance (`within_tolerance` false, all holdings `weakening`, `balancing_hint` trim_weakening_losers) but still no scoring flags. Primary underperformance with positive exclusion replay delta (+5.7% vs actual) suggests the bottleneck may be winner concentration among survivors rather than filter alpha — worth clustering loser cards (`loser_snapshot_cards.cohort_counts` avoid 43) against names that remained in the 3-slot book.
